title: Grok AI predicts DOGE price if meme coin mania returns
caption: xAI's Grok just predicted Dogecoin's price if meme mania returns in Q3 2026. The number? Specific. The method? Suspect. What this really tells us about AI price predictions.

slides.headline: Grok just predicted Dogecoin's price for Q3 2026
slides.sub: And the number is weirdly specific

slides.postStat: if meme coin mania returns in Q3 2026
slides.body: That's a 380% gain from current levels. The AI model factored in historical pump cycles, social sentiment velocity, and Elon tweet frequency as core variables.

slides.title: The methodology is peak 2026 AI
slides.body: Grok scraped 14 million crypto tweets, Reddit threads from 2021's peak, and correlation data between Musk's posting schedule and DOGE spikes. It then modeled three scenarios: bear, base, and euphoria. The $0.74 figure assumes euphoria returns.

slides.title: What Grok considered vs. what it ignored
Why this prediction matters less than you think
bullets: Grok has no proprietary trading data — just public sentiment scraping

slides.footer: Translation: entertainment value high, alpha value low.
